title: Sri Radhey Shaym v. State of U.P. & 5 Others
coram: Siddhartha Varma, J. & Manoj Bajaj, J.
disposition: Writ petition allowed; final assessment dated 15.06.2023 quashed and remitted to the Executive Engineer to consider the reply and pass a fresh final assessment; recovery citation dated 19.08.2023 quashed
headnote: Where counsel states that a final assessment is non-speaking, left the consumer's reply to the provisional assessment unconsidered, and did not comply with Clause 6.8(c)(i) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and the Electricity Department does not dispute that, the final assessment is quashed and the matter is remitted to the Executive Engineer to consider the reply and pass a fresh final assessment. The recovery citation dated 19 August 2023, founded on that assessment, is quashed with it. The writ petition is allowed. A correction allowed on 30 October 2023 requires the order to be read as: inspection 9 January 2023, provisional assessment 12 January 2023, reply 25 January 2023 later supplemented, and final assessment 15 June 2023. The Court did not decide the merits or quantum, and did not set out the text of Clause 6.8(c)(i).
facts:
Sri Radhey Shaym petitioned the Allahabad High Court against the State of U.P. and five others in Writ-C No. 31133 of 2023. An inspection on 9 January 2023 was followed by a provisional assessment dated 12 January 2023. He replied on 25 January 2023 and later supplemented that reply. A final assessment was passed on 15 June 2023, and a recovery citation dated 19 August 2023 was issued.

After adjournments, including allowance of an amendment application, the petition was heard on 19 October 2023. Counsel submitted that the final assessment was non-speaking, had not considered the reply, and did not comply with Clause 6.8(c)(i) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Counsel for the Electricity Department did not dispute that submission. A correction application allowed on 30 October 2023 directs those dates to be read as stated: the order as pronounced had transposed the inspection and provisional-assessment dates and had dated the final assessment 19 June 2023.

reusable_constructions.construction: Where it is not disputed that a final assessment is non-speaking, has not considered the consumer's reply to the provisional assessment, and does not comply with Clause 6.8(c)(i) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, that final assessment is quashed.
On such a quashing the matter is remitted to the Executive Engineer, who must consider the reply already filed and pass a fresh final assessment.
A recovery citation founded on a final assessment quashed for non-compliance with Clause 6.8(c)(i) is quashed with that assessment.

holding_units.topic: Undisputed non-speaking final assessment that leaves the reply unconsidered is quashed and remitted; the recovery citation falls with it
holding_units.question: Where the Electricity Department does not dispute that a final assessment is non-speaking, left the consumer's reply unconsidered, and did not comply with Clause 6.8(c)(i) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, can that assessment and the recovery citation founded on it stand?
holding_units.holding: No. After a provisional assessment the petitioner replied on 25.01.2023 and supplemented that reply, and a final assessment followed. Counsel stated that the final order was non-speaking, had not considered the reply, and did not comply with Clause 6.8(c)(i). Counsel for the Electricity Department did not dispute that. The final assessment was quashed and the matter remitted to the Executive Engineer to consider the reply and pass a fresh final assessment. Because the final assessment was quashed, the recovery citation dated 19.08.2023 was also quashed, and the writ petition was allowed. A correction later directed the inspection to be read as 09.01.2023, the provisional assessment as 12.01.2023, and the final assessment as 15.06.2023.
holding_units.qualifier: The Court acted on the department's concession. It did not set out the text of Clause 6.8(c)(i), examine the assessment order, or decide the merits or quantum.
holding_units.flag: Paragraphs 1–5 are the order of 19.10.2023 (Neutral Citation No. 2023:AHC:202938-DB). Civil Misc. Correction Application No. 3 of 2023, allowed on 30.10.2023, substitutes the dates used here: provisional assessment 12.01.2023 rather than 09.01.2023, inspection 09.01.2023 rather than 12.01.2023, and final assessment 15.06.2023 in paragraphs 1 and 3 rather than 19.06.2023. The recovery citation of 19.08.2023 was not corrected. Earlier sheets (13.09.2023, 10.10.2023, 12.10.2023, 16.10.2023) are adjournments and the allowance of Civil Misc. Amendment Application No. 2 of 2023. On 19.10.2023 Sri Vinayak Ranjan held brief of Sri Kartikeya Saran for the Electricity Department. The order says 'Electricity Supply Code, 2005' without a 'U.P.' prefix; catalog key UP-2005::6.8(c)(i).

principle_tags.application: The final assessment was quashed once it was not disputed that the order was non-speaking, had not considered the reply, and did not comply with Clause 6.8(c)(i).
Undisputed non-compliance with Clause 6.8(c)(i) led the Court to quash both the final assessment and the recovery citation dated 19.08.2023.
The recovery citation was quashed because it rested on the quashed final assessment, and the Executive Engineer was directed to consider the reply and pass a fresh final assessment.

not_decided.point: Merits and quantum of the assessment
not_decided.note: Left to the fresh final assessment after the Executive Engineer considers the reply.

not_decided.point: The text of Clause 6.8(c)(i) and the precise manner of breach, including whether a personal hearing was held
not_decided.note: The Court accepted the undisputed submission that the order was non-speaking, had not considered the reply, and did not comply with the clause. It did not reproduce the clause or examine the assessment order.

not_decided.point: Date and contents of the supplemental reply
not_decided.note: The order records only that the reply of 25.01.2023 was supplemented by another reply.
